disposition_reason: Primary ICP-MS measurements of 12 inorganic contaminants in eight stingless bee pot-pollen samples are printed per sample in Table 1.

study.design: Cross-sectional sampling of eight polyfloral pot-pollen samples from seven apiaries; inorganic contaminants and microbiology
study.origin: Philippines, seven apiaries (details in Belina-Aldemita et al. 2019)
study.market: collected directly from hive cerumen pots, not purchased
study.method: ICP-MS (quadrupole) after HNO3/H2O2 microwave digestion, duplicate measurements, indium internal standard
study.qa: External calibration with multi-element standard; standard uncertainty U (k = 2) from measurement precision; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: No LOD/LOQ or CRM recovery is reported for the ICP-MS determinations.
Moisture basis is not stated; samples were air-dried and dehumidified (12 h, 30 °C) before transport and analysis.
Table 2 estimated daily intakes (10 g/day, 60 kg) are derived values, not concentrations; not extracted.
Apiary locations per sample are only given in the earlier paper (Belina-Aldemita et al. 2019); sample 8 is described as from an urbanized area.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Suggested bee pollen limits cited from Campos et al. (2008): Cd 0.1, Pb 0.5, As 0.5 mg/kg
Codex maximum level for Cd in wheat used as comparator
